Content:  In accordance with the Law, you may exercise the following rights: (1) Right to be informed: You have the right to be informed of the valid legal or practical justification for collecting your personal data, and details about processing of your personal data (e.g. categories of personal data processed, purpose for collecting your personal data, the period for which the personal data will be stored, etc.). (3) Right to obtain personal data: You have the right to request your personal data held by us in a readable and clear format. (4) Right to request correction, completion of personal data: You have the right to request correction, completion or updating of your personal data which is held by us. (5) Right to request destruction of personal data: You have the right to request destruction of your personal data available to us, which is no longer required by us (subject to compliance of the requirements of the Law). (6) Right to withdraw consent: You may at any time withdraw your consent to processing of your personal data (if other legal bases for processing are not used). We inform you that you may submit a complaint to the Competent Authority, if you believe your rights have been violated. Title: Disclosure of your personal data
Content:  We may, as could be required for the purposes listed in section 4 above, disclose your Personal Data to the following organizations: (1) Any member of our group to offer you a comprehensive range of financial products and services and to enhance our business operations, (2) Current or potential suppliers, subcontractors and other business contacts in the ordinary course of our business (e.g. companies providing support of information systems, digital signature services, financial services, etc.). (3) Current or potential business partners in the banking and financial sector or other third parties involved in the management of our business. (4) Any applicable regulatory authorities (governmental and other public bodies, for example, SAMA, SAFIU, judicial authorities, courts, committees, etc.) or other third parties as could be required by law or in accordance with other regulatory obligations or policies applicable to us or to you to validate information about you (e.g. Absher, Saudi Post, Nafath, GOSI, Nafith, Yakeen, Dakhli, SIMAH). (5) Any applicable non-governmental parties, for example, Al Rajhi Group or any other third parties as could be required by law or in accordance with other regulatory obligations or policies applicable to us or to you to validate information about you. We may disclose your personal data, in the following cases: (1) You consent to the disclosure. (2) Your personal data has been collected from a publicly available source. (3) The entity requesting disclosure is a public entity, and the collection or processing of your personal data is required for public interest or security purposes, or to implement another law, or to fulfill judicial requirements. (4) The disclosure is necessary to protect public health, public safety, or to protect the lives or health of specific individuals. (5) The disclosure will only involve subsequent processing in a form that makes it impossible to directly or indirectly identify you. (6) The disclosure is necessary to achieve our legitimate interests (in this case no sensitive data (e.g. health data) will be processed). When providing your personal data to our Group companies and/or legal entities with whom we have contractual relations, we request a confirmation of the security measures these legal entities take to protect the personal data we provide. We do not share the personal data with public authorities or other third parties without a proper lawful request of the authorities. Purposes of personal data disclosure include: Absher, an online platform provided by the Saudi government to validate your national ID; Saudi Post, national postal service to validate your address; Nafath, a digital identity verification platform to validate your phone number; GOSI (General Organization for Social Insurance), administration of social insurance programs for employees to validate your income details; Nafith, Yakeen, a platform facilitating secure and efficient electronic access to financial and credit services to validate your national ID and amount to sign the contract; Dhakli, the Ministry of Interior's digital portal to validate your income details; and SIMAH, official credit bureau to help us assess your creditworthiness.
